# Blenny changelog

<!-- Generated by scripts/release_tools.py from docs/changes and docs/releases. -->

## 1.0.0 — 2026-09-30

First public release. Earlier 0.x versions were private engineering milestones.

### Added

- Separate AppKit window, settings, login and updater services; revalidate saved management intent at launch and gate update interaction during pending work.
- Ship the native Organization Board, explicit per-operation capability presentation, menu bar artwork, settings and packaged legal resources.
- Promote the accepted macOS 27 ordering and bundle-policy backend to Debug and ordinary Release, with one serial writer, fresh preflight and durable recovery.
- Retain exact single-level Undo snapshots, initial visibility backup, bounded rollback and separate persistence of user-selected preferred positions.

### Changed

- Set frequency=one-time on the status-menu GitHub Sponsors URL while preserving its project, source and menu-placement metadata.

### Fixed

- Seed the implicit initial policy before first Apply, restore sparse snapshots within approved owner scope, and permit missing-backup startup only for the exact initial visible policy after Undo.
- Use never-visible indicators for the three policy lanes and recognize all 40 locale entries (37 distinct exact label pairs) observed in macOS 27.0.1 MenuBarAgent resources, preserving native control identity and the shared reveal writer across takeover.

### Engineering

- Separate marketing-version display from diagnostic build identity; generate changelog and release notes from structured fragments and prepare a single unattended GitHub signing, packaging, publication and feed workflow.

### Requirements and limitations

- Document observed macOS 27 native Clock event, Now Playing and unattributed Gaming/Wine visibility, deferred system-item sorting and native overflow-adjacency limits without unsupported workarounds.
- Require Apple silicon, macOS 27 only and Xcode 27; retain the pinned self-signed certificate and independent Sparkle EdDSA identity, excluding test and diagnostic builds from distribution.
